QF.id: VI Functions of DP Account Opening_45

question.text: When a Beneficial Owner (BO) wishes to move all securities from one DP to another DP of the same depository, the workbook (NISM Series-VI, September 2025, pp.95-96) describes the operational mechanism. Which of the following correctly describes that source-supported procedure?

answer.text: The BO submits an account closure request to the existing DP and the securities are transferred free of charge to the new DP account; at NSDL the transfer is processed through the Transfer of Holding module
The BO must surrender the demat account holding statement to the depository, which credits the new DP account after a 30-day cooling-off period
The BO must execute an inter-depository transfer instruction, since any change of DP is treated as a cross-depository movement
The DP automatically migrates the BO's holdings on receipt of a verbal request, with no closure or instruction required

explanation.text: The Logic: Pages 95-96 of NISM Series-VI (September 2025) describe the BO submitting an account closure request to the existing DP, with the securities transferred free of charge to the new DP, and at NSDL the transfer being processed through the Transfer of Holding module. The keyed option states that procedure exactly, using only the workbook's labels. The Trap: A 30-day cooling-off period, an inter-depository instruction, or an automatic verbal migration are not described on pp.95-96. The audit flagged the original because it asked what the same-depository move is "called" - and the workbook does not crisply label it "Account transfer or shifting", while option C ("Account closure and reopening") is procedurally close because closure of the source account is part of the process. With no source label, multiple options were defensible. Note: The original was ambiguous because the source does not use the specific term "Account transfer or shifting"; it describes the procedure (account closure request, free transfer, NSDL Transfer of Holding module). The stem has been rewritten to ask for the source-supported procedure (not the label), making the closure-request / free-transfer / Transfer of Holding option uniquely correct per pp.95-96.
